regions.name: Long head
regions.description: The outer head crosses the shoulder and contributes to elbow flexion and forearm supination.
regions.note: Both biceps heads contribute; shoulder position changes their loading.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions: Sit against an incline bench with your arms hanging naturally. Curl the dumbbells without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulders comfortable; avoid forcing the arms behind you.
exercises.alsoWorks: Short head of biceps, brachialis, brachioradialis

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions: Begin with arms at your sides. Curl the weights while turning palms upward. Lower to a comfortable straight-arm position.
exercises.cue: Keep elbows near your ribs and your torso still.
exercises.alsoWorks: Short head of biceps, brachialis, brachioradialis

regions.name: Short head
regions.description: The inner head works alongside the long head during curls and pulling movements.
regions.note: These curls train both heads rather than isolating the short head.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.instructions: Support your upper arms on the pad and curl through a comfortable range. Lower gradually.
exercises.cue: Avoid bouncing at the bottom or forcing elbow extension.
exercises.alsoWorks: Long head of biceps, brachialis, brachioradialis

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions: Begin with arms at your sides. Curl the weights while turning palms upward. Lower to a comfortable straight-arm position.
exercises.cue: Keep elbows near your ribs and your torso still.
exercises.alsoWorks: Long head of biceps, brachialis, brachioradialis

regions.name: Brachialis · supporting muscle
regions.description: Located beneath the biceps, the brachialis bends the elbow regardless of forearm position.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Bend the elbows and lift, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Maintain the neutral wrist position throughout.
exercises.alsoWorks: Biceps brachii, brachioradialis

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.instructions: Hold light dumbbells with palms facing down. Bend the elbows to lift, keeping your wrists neutral, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep elbows near your sides and avoid lifting with wrist extension.
exercises.alsoWorks: Brachioradialis, biceps brachii; wrist extensors stabilize

regions.name: Long head
regions.description: Crosses the shoulder as well as the elbow. Overhead extensions train it at a longer muscle length.
regions.note: The overhead position lengthens the long head. All three heads extend the elbow.

exercises.name: Overhead cable extension
exercises.instructions: Face away from a low cable with hands overhead. Extend your elbows, then return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your trunk braced and use a comfortable shoulder position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Lateral and medial triceps heads

exercises.name: Cable pressdown
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with elbows at your sides. Extend the elbows to move the handle down, then return under control.
exercises.cue: Keep the upper arms still and wrists neutral.
exercises.alsoWorks: Lateral and medial triceps heads

regions.name: Lateral head
regions.description: The outer head contributes to forceful elbow extension.
regions.note: These movements load all three triceps heads.

exercises.name: Cable pressdown
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with elbows at your sides. Extend the elbows to move the handle down, then return under control.
exercises.cue: Keep the upper arms still and wrists neutral.
exercises.alsoWorks: Long and medial triceps heads

exercises.name: Close-grip push-up
exercises.instructions: Place your hands slightly narrower than shoulder width. Lower your chest while keeping a straight body line, then press up.
exercises.cue: Keep elbows angled back. Elevate your hands to reduce difficulty.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other triceps heads, pectoralis major, anterior deltoids

regions.name: Medial head
regions.description: The deeper head supports elbow extension across a wide range of movements.
regions.note: The medial head works alongside the other heads during elbow extension.

exercises.name: Cable pressdown
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with elbows at your sides. Extend the elbows to move the handle down, then return under control.
exercises.cue: Keep the upper arms still and wrists neutral.
exercises.alsoWorks: Long and lateral triceps heads

exercises.name: Overhead cable extension
exercises.instructions: Face away from a low cable with hands overhead. Extend your elbows, then return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your trunk braced and use a comfortable shoulder position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Long and lateral triceps heads

regions.name: Brachioradialis
regions.description: Bends the elbow most effectively around a neutral, thumb-up forearm position.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing inward. Bend the elbows without swinging, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your wrists neutral. The biceps and brachialis also contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Brachialis, biceps brachii

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.instructions: Hold light dumbbells with palms facing down. Bend the elbows to lift, keeping your wrists neutral, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep elbows near your sides and avoid lifting with wrist extension.
exercises.alsoWorks: Brachialis, biceps brachii; wrist extensors stabilize

regions.name: Flexor carpi radialis
regions.description: Flexes the wrist and moves it toward the thumb side.

exercises.name: Wrist flexion with radial bias
exercises.instructions: Support your forearm palm-up. Curl the wrist slightly toward the thumb side, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the forearm supported; do not force sideways movement.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other wrist flexors; radial wrist extensors stabilize

regions.name: Flexor carpi ulnaris
regions.description: Flexes the wrist and moves it toward the little-finger side.

exercises.name: Wrist flexion with ulnar bias
exercises.instructions: Support your forearm palm-up. Gently curl the wrist toward the little-finger side, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Use a small range and light resistance. Other wrist flexors still contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other wrist flexors; extensor carpi ulnaris assists ulnar deviation

regions.name: Flexor digitorum superficialis
regions.description: Bends the middle finger joints and contributes to grip.

exercises.name: Soft putty squeeze
exercises.instructions: Wrap your fingers around soft putty, squeeze smoothly, then release completely.
exercises.cue: Keep the wrist neutral and avoid maximum-effort squeezing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor digitorum profundus, thumb flexors, intrinsic hand muscles

regions.name: Flexor digitorum profundus
regions.description: Deep muscle that bends the fingertips and supports grip.

exercises.name: Soft putty squeeze
exercises.instructions: Wrap your fingers around soft putty, squeeze smoothly, then release completely.
exercises.cue: Keep the wrist neutral and avoid maximum-effort squeezing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor digitorum superficialis, thumb flexors, intrinsic hand muscles

regions.name: Flexor pollicis longus
regions.description: Bends the thumb tip and contributes to pinch.

exercises.name: Thumb putty press
exercises.instructions: Press your thumb into soft putty toward the palm, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the thumb joints aligned; do not force the end position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor pollicis brevis, other thenar muscles

regions.name: Extensor carpi radialis longus & brevis
regions.description: Extend the wrist and assist movement toward the thumb side.

exercises.name: Reverse wrist curl
exercises.instructions: Support your forearms with palms down. Lift the backs of your hands by extending the wrists, then lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the forearms supported and use a small, controlled range.
exercises.alsoWorks: Extensor carpi ulnaris, finger extensors

regions.name: Extensor carpi ulnaris
regions.description: Extends the wrist and moves it toward the little-finger side.

exercises.name: Wrist extension with ulnar bias
exercises.instructions: With forearm supported palm-down, lift the wrist slightly toward the little-finger side. Return with control.
exercises.cue: Use a small motion without swinging the elbow.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other wrist extensors; flexor carpi ulnaris assists ulnar deviation

regions.name: Extensor digitorum
regions.description: Straightens the fingers and helps extend the wrist.

exercises.name: Band finger opening
exercises.instructions: Place a light band around the fingers. Open them slowly against resistance, then return.
exercises.cue: Keep the movement controlled and the wrist steady.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other finger extensors, dorsal interossei

regions.name: Extensor pollicis longus & brevis
regions.description: Straighten the thumb at its joints.

exercises.name: Resisted thumb extension
exercises.instructions: Place a light band around your thumb and hand. Straighten and lift your thumb away from the palm, then return.
exercises.cue: Use light tension and keep the wrist still.
exercises.alsoWorks: Abductor pollicis longus; wrist extensors stabilize

regions.name: Abductor pollicis longus
regions.description: Moves the thumb away from the hand at its base.
regions.note: Thumb abduction loads several muscles; the exact contribution depends on the direction of movement.

exercises.name: Thumb lift
exercises.instructions: With your palm facing up, lift your thumb away from the plane of the palm against light resistance.
exercises.cue: Keep the thumb gently curved and the wrist supported.
exercises.alsoWorks: Abductor pollicis brevis and other thumb stabilizers

regions.name: Pronator teres
regions.description: Turns the palm downward and assists elbow flexion.

exercises.name: Resisted forearm pronation
exercises.instructions: Support your elbow and forearm. Holding a light lever near its weighted end, turn your palm downward and return slowly.
exercises.cue: Start with a short lever and keep your elbow still.
exercises.alsoWorks: Pronator quadratus; wrist stabilizers

regions.name: Pronator quadratus
regions.description: Deep distal forearm muscle that turns the palm downward.

exercises.name: Resisted forearm pronation
exercises.instructions: Support your elbow and forearm. Holding a light lever near its weighted end, turn your palm downward and return slowly.
exercises.cue: Start with a short lever and keep your elbow still.
exercises.alsoWorks: Pronator teres; wrist stabilizers

regions.name: Supinator
regions.description: Deep proximal forearm muscle that turns the palm upward.

exercises.name: Resisted forearm supination
exercises.instructions: Support your elbow and forearm. Use a light lever to resist turning the palm upward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the movement at the forearm rather than rotating your shoulder.
exercises.alsoWorks: Biceps brachii; wrist stabilizers

regions.name: Abductor pollicis brevis
regions.description: Lifts the thumb away from the plane of the palm.

exercises.name: Thumb lift
exercises.instructions: With your palm facing up, lift your thumb away from the plane of the palm against light resistance.
exercises.cue: Keep the thumb gently curved and the wrist supported.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other thenar muscles stabilize the thumb

regions.name: Flexor pollicis brevis
regions.description: Bends the thumb at its large knuckle.

exercises.name: Thumb putty press
exercises.instructions: Press your thumb into soft putty toward the palm, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the thumb joints aligned; do not force the end position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor pollicis longus, other thenar muscles

regions.name: Opponens pollicis
regions.description: Rotates and draws the thumb across the palm for opposition.

exercises.name: Thumb opposition with putty
exercises.instructions: Place soft putty near the base of your little finger. Bring the thumb across the palm to press into it.
exercises.cue: Move the thumb base rather than only bending the tip.
exercises.alsoWorks: Abductor pollicis brevis, flexor pollicis brevis

regions.name: Adductor pollicis
regions.description: Draws the thumb toward the hand, supporting key pinch.

exercises.name: Gentle key pinch
exercises.instructions: Hold soft putty between the thumb pad and the side of your index finger. Squeeze gently, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the thumb aligned and avoid locking its joints.
exercises.alsoWorks: First dorsal interosseous, thumb flexors

regions.name: Hypothenar muscles
regions.description: Abductor digiti minimi, flexor digiti minimi brevis, and opponens digiti minimi control the little-finger side of the hand.

exercises.name: Little-finger opposition
exercises.instructions: Cup the little-finger side of your palm toward the thumb, gently compressing soft putty.
exercises.cue: Use a small controlled motion without bending the wrist.
exercises.alsoWorks: Thenar muscles, finger flexors

regions.name: Lumbricals
regions.description: Bend the large finger knuckles while helping straighten the middle and end joints.

exercises.name: Knuckle press into putty
exercises.instructions: Keep the finger tips relatively straight and bend at the large knuckles to press into soft putty. Release slowly.
exercises.cue: Avoid collapsing the middle finger joints.
exercises.alsoWorks: Interossei; finger extensors coordinate joint position

regions.name: Dorsal interossei
regions.description: Spread the fingers apart and assist knuckle control.

exercises.name: Resisted finger spread
exercises.instructions: Spread your fingers apart against a light loop, then bring them back under control.
exercises.cue: Keep the wrist still and fingers comfortably extended.
exercises.alsoWorks: Abductor digiti minimi; finger extensors stabilize

regions.name: Palmar interossei
regions.description: Draw the fingers together and help coordinate knuckle movement.

exercises.name: Finger adduction press
exercises.instructions: Place a small piece of soft putty between adjacent fingers. Bring the fingers together to compress it.
exercises.cue: Use gentle pressure without twisting the fingers.
exercises.alsoWorks: Lumbricals; finger flexors and extensors stabilize
